user.title: EG Austria token

data_description.token: Personal token or session cookie value. Surrounding quotes and `portal.jwtToken=` are removed automatically.

token_expiry.title: Personal token expiry
token_expiry.description: The integration can't read the expiry of a personal token. Enter the date you chose when creating it (the portal default is one year). You get a repair warning 30 days before.

expiring_soon.title: Session token expires soon
expiring_soon.description: This session token expires in {days} days. Setup continues, but you will have to paste a new token soon. A personal token avoids this.

member.title: Member
member.description: This login can act for several members. Choose the one to add.

accept_terms.title: Portal terms
accept_terms.description: The portal reports that the terms of use for this member have not been accepted yet. Log in to the member portal in a browser and accept them, or the data requests may fail.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose the location (site) for this entry. Add another entry for another location.

site.title: Metering points
site.description: Choose the metering points of this site. The site slug is part of the statistic ids (for example `eg_austria:home_consumption` for the slug `home`) and can't be changed later.

data_description.site_slug: Lower case letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters. The statistics are shown as "Home".

communities.title: Energy communities

reauth_confirm.title: New EG Austria token
reauth_confirm.description: The stored token was rejected or has expired. Paste a new personal token (recommended, see {readme_url}) or session cookie of the same member.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EG Austria
reconfigure.description: Optionally paste a new token before the current one expires (see {readme_url}). Leave empty to keep the stored token. Next you can change the metering points and add communities.

reconfigure_location.title: Location changed
reconfigure_location.description: The stored location is no longer returned by the portal (its id may have changed). Choose the location this site belongs to; statistic ids stay the same.

reconfigure_communities.title: Energy communities

error.invalid_token_format: This is neither a personal token (`ecapi_…`) nor a session token (JWT).
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different member.
error.terms_not_accepted: The portal rejected the request. Accept the terms of use in the member portal first.
error.no_member: No member is linked to this login.
error.cannot_connect: The portal can't be reached right now. Try again later.
error.api_changed: The portal answered in an unexpected format. Please report an issue.
error.no_metering_point: Select at least one metering point.
error.no_community: The selected metering points are in no energy community (or none is selected).
error.invalid_slug: Use 1-20 lower case letters, digits or `_`, starting with a letter.
error.slug_in_use: This site slug is already used by another entry.
error.duplicate_slug: This slug is already used in this entry.

abort.already_configured: This member and location are already configured.
abort.no_location: The portal returned no location for this member.
abort.no_metering_points: The location has no metering points.
abort.too_many_communities: More energy communities than this version supports.

data.import_history: Import history from the first activation

data_description.max_hourly_kwh: Hourly values above this are held back as implausible.
data_description.daily_window_days: The last days fetched again on every daily run.
data_description.long_refetch_months: Months fetched again by the monthly run (late corrections).

refetch.name: Re-fetch
refetch.description: Fetches a date range again from the member portal and rewrites its statistics. Runs in the background.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The EG Austria entry to run.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day to fetch. Default: the daily window (62 days).

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to fetch. Default: today. At most 400 days after the start date.

release_held.name: Release held days
release_held.description: Releases days that validation held back, so the next run writes them as the portal sends them.

statistic_key.name: Statistic key
statistic_key.description: Only this statistic, for example home_generation. Default: all.

date.name: Date
date.description: Only this day. Default: all held days.

entry_not_found.message: No EG Austria entry with this id.

entry_not_loaded.message: The EG Austria entry is not loaded.

invalid_range.message: The start date must not be after the end date, and the end date must not be in the future.

range_too_long.message: A re-fetch covers at most {days} days.

run_in_progress.message: An import is already running for this entry. Try again when it has finished.

token_expiring.title: EG Austria token expires soon
token_expiring.description:
The portal token of {title} expires on {expires} (in {days} days). After that no data is imported until a new token is stored.

Create a new token (a personal access token is recommended) and paste it with **Reconfigure** on the EG Austria integration page. This message disappears once the new token is saved.

api_changed.title: EG Austria portal response changed
api_changed.description:
On {date} a response from the EG Austria portal for {title} did not match the expected format (rules: {rules}). To protect your statistics nothing was written. The integration keeps trying daily and clears this message after a run validates.

Please download the diagnostics of this entry (they are redacted) and attach them to an issue report in the integration's issue tracker.

stale_client.title: EG Austria portal was updated
stale_client.description:
On {date} the EG Austria portal told {title} that the member portal was updated and this client is out of date. To protect your statistics nothing was written. The integration keeps trying daily and clears this message after a run validates.

Check for an update of the integration. If there is none yet, please download the diagnostics of this entry (they are redacted) and attach them to an issue report.

implausible_data.title: EG Austria data held back
implausible_data.description:
Some data for {title} failed a plausibility check and was not written (rules: {rules}; statistics: {statistics}; dates: {dates}). Everything else was imported.

The next run checks these days again and clears this message when they pass. If you have confirmed in the portal that the values are correct, call the action **EG Austria: Release held days** to write them with the next run.

portal_unreachable.title: EG Austria portal unreachable
portal_unreachable.description: The EG Austria portal could not be reached for {title} on {days} consecutive days (last successful import: {last_success}). Imports continue automatically when the portal answers again; no data is lost as long as the portal still offers it.
